status: CANDIDATE, not a pinned record: PALW_TIR_FRAME_COST_RECORDS_V1 stays empty. Values marked network-input are not yet observed on testnet-12; arming needs them observed with the shipped binary (V5/V6/V7) and a reviewed record.
host: Apple M1 Max, 10 cores, 32 GiB, Darwin 25.6.0, release build (lto thin, overflow checks)

inclusion_margin_daa.source: network_v1 (unchanged); testnet-12 inclusion latency is a network-input to observe

reorg_replay_moves.source: network-input: one restart turn per door; was 64 (a multiplier on every pass and turn). The V7 restart/reorg drill observes it

acquisition_daa.source: measured: the slowest single build on this host (court check 93 ms, publication 66 ms, cold answer slice 7.5 ms, FP execute 3.1 ms) is far below one testnet-12 DAA (~171 s at the release plan's 21 DAA/h); genesis-size classes are not measured

collection_daa.source: derived: two inclusion margins (the collecting move and its inclusion); a filing is held by the filing allowance

action_parser_steps.source: measured: read action (Demand/Begin/Part/Finish) fitted a + b*upper over uppers 6 and 257, a = 75.7 us, plus one ML-DSA-87 verify 97.7 us, at 50.02 parser steps per ns (one full-frame pass: 1.727 ms over 2,700,334 B at 32 steps per byte)

action_parser_steps_per_custodian.source: measured: b = 0.919 us per custodian of the upper

frame_passes_per_check.source: measured: Open 1.90 ms and filing 1.32 ms at upper 257 against one pass of 1.73 ms, rounded up

control_bytes.source: measured control 7,101 B (largest non-part control) plus one ML-DSA-87 carrier input (signature 4,627 B and key 2,592 B, protocol constants)

parallel_bytes_per_daa.source: ceiling, network-input: testnet-12 max_block_mass 500,000 / TRANSIENT_BYTE_TO_MASS_FACTOR 4 at one block a DAA, no other traffic; the frame's share under contention is to be observed
